Good to know

A thoughtful visit,
from the start.

How do I request an appointment?+

Choose your treatment and preferences, then review your request. You can copy or download it and contact Supreme. Nothing is reserved or sent automatically.

What does a mobile visit cost?+

Your treatment price plus travel. Within Antwerp, travel is estimated at €9.99–€14.99 per visit. Outside Antwerp, the fee is agreed with you based on total travel distance. The exact fee, including arrangements for two therapists, is confirmed before booking.

Is my preferred time available?+

Dates and times are preferences until Supreme confirms them. Live calendar availability is not connected.

Can I book a subscription?+

Subscription plans, prices and billing terms are still being prepared. No membership can be purchased or activated yet.

What happens to my details?+

Your request stays in this page until you choose to copy or download it. The site does not send your details automatically. Review contact details also stay in page memory until you clear them or leave Reviews. Copying, downloading or choosing an email handoff is your choice. Intro and gym or spa preferences use session storage; no payment details are collected.

Privacy

Privacy on this website

Your details stay with you

Appointment and review details stay in this page’s memory. They are cleared when you close the request, leave Reviews or reload. They are not automatically sent to Supreme or stored on a server.

Copies you choose to keep

A copied or downloaded request or review remains on your device and can include your contact details. An email handoff opens your own email app; you decide whether to send it.

Simple browser preferences

Your language choice is remembered on this device when browser storage is available. The intro preference and gym or spa selection last for the session. This site does not use analytics or advertising trackers.

Links to other websites

Contact links open Supreme’s original website. External websites and email providers have their own privacy practices.
